what: BWD-KEEP (2026-10-23): the binary32 attention backward keeps every probability-adjoint tile of a row block in its task's region of the lent workspace (ATT-CONTIG's, from BCIR_ATT_CONTIG_FROM positions where a row holds more than one head, now also holding 32 rows of the context's width after the seven copies), so its second pass reads the tiles its first evaluated where it evaluated those past the first 256 columns again -- three quarters of them at T2048 -- every value as it was. Measured on the committed tree against the tree before it: the cross-build hashes, the attention with both units in one process beside an A/A control, both lent the larger need, the decoder's training step, the GEO study's attention model's training update built as the study builds it against PyTorch, and the attention against PyTorch's scaled_dot_product_attention; and the design runs: the GEO step a part at a time, and the prototype that kept every tile on the stack.
